supporting_observations.claim: GradeBook Pro's updater started on WS-RDIAZ-01 under raul.diaz at 13:40:48 UTC with the background command, immediately before the first recorded connection to update.gradebookpro.com.
The updater process (PID 4984) is directly associated with repeated proxy connections to update.gradebookpro.com:443, including at 13:40, 13:51, 13:56, 14:00, 14:05, and 14:10 UTC.

The roughly five-minute cadence, approved updater executable, and approved update host match the organization's stated GradeBook Pro update behavior; this supports a benign explanation for the alerted connections.
One recorded updater request received proxy status 407 at 13:46; subsequent recorded requests to the same update host succeeded with status 200.

known_telemetry_limitations: The updater connections are logged as HTTPS proxy tunnels; these records do not show the encrypted request or response contents.
The supplied records do not provide a hash, signature verification, or provenance for the updater executable.
The earliest recorded GradeBook Pro updater connection in this evidence is at 13:40:56 UTC; the supplied records do not attribute any activity from 13:30 to that time to the updater.
claims_not_established: The contents of the HTTPS traffic or whether any update payload was downloaded and executed.
Whether the updater executable on disk is authentic and unmodified.
Whether any periodic HTTPS activity before the first recorded updater connection at 13:40:56 UTC was part of the same activity.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox.exe was launched by raul.diaz from the Dropbox client installation; Dropbox is an unapproved cloud-storage service in this environment. Triage separately; it does not determine this alert. Records: T266-00215, T266-00216, T266-00217.

An executable named KB5034441_update.exe ran from C:\Windows\Temp under raul.diaz with a quiet argument; the supplied records do not establish its source or legitimacy. Triage separately; it does not determine this alert. Records: T266-00242, T266-00243.
